To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of a visual analytics system can help analysts understand the impact of different feature selection algorithms and classifiers on the prediction of a given dataset, and 2) the use of such a system can help analysts to understand which features are most important to a predictive model and how they are being ranked by different feature selection algorithms.

INFUSE helps users understand the relationship among feature selection methods, cross validation folds and classifiers by visualizing the feature rankings produced by each method, fold and classifier.
INFUSE can help users to understand the relative importance of features across feature selection algorithms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the usability of predictive modeling techniques and the interpretability of the models produced.
how to support analysts in making decisions about which features to include in predictive models, particularly in the context of high dimensional data.
the problem of feature selection and how to improve the process for analysts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our system is a novel visual analytics approach that enables analysts to understand the impact of feature selection algorithms on predictive models.
INFUSE is a novel visual analytics tool that allows analysts to explore and understand the results of different feature selection algorithms.
we developed a visual analytics system to support the selection of predictive features for high-dimensional data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
INFUSE is a visual analytics system that helps data scientists to better understand the feature selection process.
we developed a system that allows analysts to explore how different feature selection techniques, classifiers, and cross validation folds affect the ranking of predictive features.
we have designed and implemented an interactive visual analytics system to help data scientists understand the results of predictive feature ranking.

by visualizing how features are ranked across different feature selection algorithms, analysts can better interpret the results of predictive modeling.
